arms: untouched Base K1 and promoted trace child K3, otherwise released verbal parent K3
gsm: Publisher train split, no annotation markers, remove all observed historical training questions and first 12 historical reserved items. Two fixed independent arithmetic demonstrations, answer-only raw completion, first complete line or end, greedy, cap 32. Strict numeric score across all items.
arc: ARC-Easy validation, 4 nonempty choices. Natural question followed by Answer: and each choice as continuation. Primary mean continuation log probability per choice token; also report unnormalized sum. Full tied vocabulary normalization, identical input tokens in both arms.
gate: exploratory external improvement requires >=2 net GSM correct and no loss of more than one ARC item; freeze before any comparison. Keep both cohorts for longitudinal scoring only.
